max_num_batched_tokens.condition: measure long-prefill and short-decode interference on matched mixed traffic

long_prefill_token_threshold.condition: chunked prefill stays enabled; interpret only when long-prefill contention is observed

enforce_eager.condition: report startup and steady-state separately; eager mode must be verified in pinned vLLM logs

max_num_seqs.condition: diagnostic axis: verify actual active-sequence demand and queueing at the measured rate; lower caps can induce artificial queueing and are not presumed beneficial

gpu_memory_utilization.condition: diagnostic axis: verify startup, allocated KV capacity, occupancy and preemption; no latency or capacity benefit is presumed without KV pressure

enable_prefix_caching.condition: requires token-exact repeated-prefix workload and measured cache hits

mtp_draft_tokens.condition: requires accepted-token telemetry and semantic answer-quality checks

enable_chunked_prefill.condition: held at baseline in this campaign

rules: Every candidate uses the same frozen mixed screen and matched B0 protocol.
The fast screen gives exploratory throughput and latency observations, not tail-SLA evidence.
Sequence-cap and memory-fraction changes are diagnostic unless measured queue or KV pressure establishes a mechanism.
Prefix caching and MTP remain fixed until separate mechanism and quality gates pass.
